scope: Completed reused frozen-v11 stock teacher and fixed public-input integrity. No independent strength sample, fitted learner or serving activation.

registration.composition: 190 explicit public/static candidate values plus one outside-option indicator. IDs only join public actors/targets; only first native catalog, before and cleanup proposals. All later forecasts/actions/outcomes stay outside X.
registration.folds: Preserve original955/272/285 whole-family train/validation/test assignment and every zero-observation case. Separate compressed feature files. No held-out class/performance output or model/threshold/recipe selection.
registration.sourceContract: Bound AST facts: sole later list append requires productive tier, disabled for eligible barrels or the only Healer wait rewrite. No direct list mutation or engine action-parameter property write. Complete source eligibility/incumbent/static-lap checks required on every observation; not a transitive program-purity theorem.
registration.unknownAndMissingPolicy: Retain missing native catalogs and missing/dead spell recipients as explicit inference abstentions. Retain every outside-catalog selected action as an outside-option label. Never call graveyard recipients illegal merely because they are absent from active units.
gates: Parent complete6048 original controls,28 preflight and72 cold executions pass both frozen verifiers; verify every raw file SHA before assembly.

All6048 cases/1512 family folds and all source observations retained. All eligible source paths, first-catalog shape, raw incumbent/Healer rewrite, finite static metadata and lap exact. Zero accepted teacher actions falsely masked.

Independent Python verifies every source-label/action-key join, fold/case ledger, all33 new static/mechanics/recipient values, partial masks, original-proposal flags and outside/shared-state construction.
No heldout class/performance metric, fitter, new battle, default or deployment. The old805-label test remains closed. Any input violation stops the phase with all rows and counterexamples preserved.
registration.termination: One complete assembly and independent verification attempt after fully verified parent. No parent actor restart, retry, cutoff extension, row omission or input gate relaxation.

dataRequirements: Eligible observed cleanup is a melee deployment-barrel fallback with pre-cleanup movement/hold and no explicit combat/spell.
First native input, when present, starts with the cleanup incumbent or the one Healer wait rewrite. Missing native catalogs remain explicit abstentions.
No post-probe candidate append can occur on these paths: a retained barrel disables productive tier; a wait rewrite is outside its hard-passive kind set.
Only first native input metadata is admitted. Later shortlist outputs, query scores, action attempts and actual choices are excluded from X.
sourceContract.limitation: These source-bound facts plus full functional/cold controls and complete data checks establish this input contract for the frozen implementation; this is not a general transitive-purity proof or current-v12 qualification.

independent.scope: Validates exact source-label joins, explicit33-feature suffix, flags and outside/shared-state construction. Earlier157-feature numeric implementation has separate metamorphic/functional tests; not fully reimplemented here.

"""Independent label joins, masks, explicit static feature suffix, folds and outside-option checks."""
from pathlib import Path
import gzip,hashlib,json,math
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;parent=p.parent/'barrel-catalog-teacher-v11-20261118';sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
regraw=(p/'registration.json').read_bytes();reg=json.loads(regraw);seal=sha(regraw);primary=json.loads((p/'assembly-result.json').read_text());assert primary['passed']and primary['registrationSha256']==seal
for f in reg['files']:assert sha((p/f['path']).read_bytes())==f['sha256'],f['path']
for f in primary['files']:assert sha((p/f['path']).read_bytes())==f['sha256']
features=json.loads((p/'prepared/feature-names.json').read_text());assert len(features)==191 and features[-1]=='outsideOption'
source_cases={j['caseId']:j for j in json.loads((parent/'cases-all.json').read_text())};rows={};families={}
for fold in ['train','validation','test']:
 for line in gzip.open(p/f'prepared/{fold}.jsonl.gz','rt'):
  r=json.loads(line);assert r['fold']==fold and r['rowId']not in rows;rows[r['rowId']]=r
  prior=families.setdefault(r['familyId'],fold);assert prior==fold
  assert len(r['features'])==len(r['valid'])==r['outsideIndex']+1 and r['valid'][-1]and 0<=r['targetIndex']<len(r['features'])and r['valid'][r['targetIndex']]
  for i,x in enumerate(r['features']):assert len(x)==191 and all(type(v)in[int,float]and math.isfinite(v)for v in x)and x[-1]==(1 if i==r['outsideIndex']else 0)
  for index,name in enumerate(features[:-1]):
   keep=name.startswith(('actor.','allies.','enemies.','map.'))or name in['lap','activeTimeDenial']
   assert r['features'][-1][index]==(r['features'][0][index]if keep else 0)
def normalized(actions):
 out=[]
 for original in actions:
  a=dict(original)
  if a['type']in['move_unit','melee_attack','obstacle_attack']:a['hasLavaCell']=bool(a.get('hasLavaCell',False));a['hasWaterCell']=bool(a.get('hasWaterCell',False))
  if'targetCells'in a:a['targetCells']=sorted(a['targetCells'],key=lambda c:(c['x'],c['y']))
  out.append(a)
 return out
static_names=['moraleDelta','luckDelta','enemiesNotYetActedFrac','alliesNotYetActedFrac','lap','hourglassSpent','spendsRangeShot','spendsSpellCharge','burnsResurrectionCharge','expectedDamage','expectedKill']
shot_names=['enemyDamage','friendlyFireDamage','primaryTargetDamage','targetFirepower','targetLevel','targetIsRanged','targetCanCastSpells','targetNotYetActed','targetWoundedFraction','targetFocusFire']
spell_names=['level','spell_target_type','power_type','multiplier_type','element','self_debuff_applies','is_giftable','maximum_gift_level']
checked=set();source_counts={};verified=0
for host in ['local','puffalo']:
 for f in sorted((parent/f'collection-{host}').glob('worker-*-labels.*.jsonl.gz')):
  for line in gzip.open(f,'rt'):
   payload=json.loads(line);case_id=payload['jobId'][11:];j=source_cases[case_id];assert case_id not in checked;checked.add(case_id);source_counts[case_id]=len(payload['labels'])
   assert j['familyId']==payload['familyId']and j['fold']==payload['fold']and j['assignedHost']==host
   for o in payload['labels']:
    key=case_id+'/'+str(o['ordinal']);r=rows.pop(key);assert r['familyId']==j['familyId']and r['fold']==j['fold'];verified+=1
    units=o['publicState']['units'];actor=next(u for u in units if u['id']==o['unitId']);roots=o['rootRecords'];native=roots[0]['shortlists'][0]['input']if roots and roots[0]['shortlists']else[]
    assert actor['attackSelection']!=2 and not any(a['type']in['melee_attack','range_attack','area_throw_attack','cast_spell','obstacle_attack']for a in o['before'])and any(a['type']in['move_unit','wait_turn','defend_turn']for a in o['before'])
    strike=next(a for a in o['cleanup']if a['type']=='obstacle_attack');g=o['publicState']['gridGeometry'];cell={'x':math.floor((strike['targetPosition']['x']+g['maxX'])/g['cellSize']),'y':math.floor(strike['targetPosition']['y']/g['cellSize'])}
    assert strike['attackerId']==o['unitId']and any(b['cell']==cell for b in o['publicState']['barrels'])
    if native:
     first=native[0];same=normalized(first['actions'])==normalized(o['cleanup']);wait=actor['name']=='Healer'and first['actions']==[{'type':'wait_turn','unitId':o['unitId']}]
     assert roots[0]['version']=='v0.8'and first['kind']=='incumbent'and normalized(roots[0]['rawIncumbent'])==normalized(o['cleanup'])and(same or wait)
     for candidate in native:assert candidate.get('features')and all(type(v)in[int,float]and math.isfinite(v)for v in candidate['features'].values())and candidate['features']['lap']==o['lap']
    plans=[];records=[]
    for actions in[c['actions']for c in native]+[o['cleanup'],o['before']]:
     norm=normalized(actions)
     if norm not in plans:plans.append(norm);records.append(next((c for c in native if normalized(c['actions'])==norm),None))
    assert len(plans)==r['outsideIndex'];actual=normalized(o['chosenDecision']);target=plans.index(actual)if actual in plans else len(plans);assert target==r['targetIndex']
    assert r['cleanupIndex']==plans.index(normalized(o['cleanup']))and r['beforeIndex']==plans.index(normalized(o['before']))
    requires_abstention=False
    for i,(actions,record)in enumerate(zip(plans,records)):
     row=r['features'][i];cast=next((a for a in actions if a['type']=='cast_spell'),None);attack=next((a for a in actions if a['type']in['range_attack','melee_attack']),None)
     spell=next((s for s in actor['spells']if cast and s['name']==cast['spellName']),None)
     recipient=next((u for u in units if cast and cast.get('targetId')and u['id']==cast['targetId']),None);attack_target=next((u for u in units if attack and attack.get('targetId')and u['id']==attack['targetId']),None)
     missing=bool(cast and cast.get('targetId')and recipient is None);dead=bool(recipient and recipient['dead']);requires_abstention|=missing or dead
     blocked=(any(a['type']=='wait_turn'for a in actions)and not actor['turnLegality']['canWait'])or bool(attack and attack.get('targetId')and(attack_target is None or attack_target['dead']))or bool(cast and(spell is None or spell['remaining']<=0))
     assert r['valid'][i]==(not blocked)
     static=record.get('features')if record else None;shot=record.get('shotFeatures')if record else None;sp=spell['properties']if spell else{}
     expected={'hasNativeStaticMetadata':int(static is not None),'hasNativeShotMetadata':int(shot is not None),'spellTargetOutsideActiveRoster':int(missing),'spellTargetDeadInRoster':int(dead)}
     expected.update({'native.'+k:(static.get(k,0)if static else 0)for k in static_names});expected.update({'native.shot.'+k:(shot.get(k,0)if shot else 0)for k in shot_names});expected.update({'spell.'+k:sp.get(k,0)for k in spell_names})
     for name,value in expected.items():assert row[features.index(name)]==value,(key,name)
     assert row[features.index('isCleanup')]==(i==r['cleanupIndex'])and row[features.index('isBefore')]==(i==r['beforeIndex'])
    assert r['allowInference']==(bool(native)and not requires_abstention)
assert not rows and len(checked)==6048 and verified==primary['observations']
ledger=json.loads((p/'prepared/case-ledger.json').read_text());assert len(ledger)==6048 and len({r['caseId']for r in ledger})==6048 and len({r['familyId']for r in ledger})==1512
for r in ledger:assert r['observations']==source_counts[r['caseId']]and r['familyId']==source_cases[r['caseId']]['familyId']and r['fold']==source_cases[r['caseId']]['fold']
result={'passed':True,'registrationSha256':seal,'sourceCasesVerified':6048,'wholeSourceFamiliesVerified':1512,'observationLabelJoinsVerified':verified,'featureCount':191,
 'allProducerFileHashesExact':True,'allOutsideAndOriginalFoldCasesRetained':True,'allActualTargetsPartialMasksOutsideRowsAnd33StaticSuffixFieldsIndependentlyVerified':True,
 'scope':'Validates exact source-label joins, explicit33-feature suffix, flags and outside/shared-state construction. Earlier157-feature numeric implementation has separate metamorphic/functional tests; not fully reimplemented here.',
 'heldoutClassOrPerformanceMetricsNotInspected':True,'modelFitted':False,'defaultChanged':False,'newIndependentStrengthSamples':0}
with(p/'independent-assembly-verification.json').open('x')as f:f.write(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))

from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,os,shutil,subprocess,time
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;parent=p.parent/'barrel-catalog-teacher-v11-20261118';regraw=(p/'registration.json').read_bytes();reg=json.loads(regraw);seal=hashlib.sha256(regraw).hexdigest()
state={'complete':False,'stage':'waiting-for-fully-verified-parent','supervisorPid':os.getpid(),'registrationSha256':seal,'errors':[],'modelFitterChosenOrStarted':False,'defaultChanged':False}
def save():
 state['at']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();f=p/'supervisor-status.tmp';f.write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\n');f.replace(p/'supervisor-status.json')
save()
try:
 while True:
  assert time.time()<reg['deadlineUnix'],'Fixed input-assembly cutoff; no extension'
  s=json.loads((parent/'operations-status.json').read_text());assert not s['errors'],s
  if s['complete']:break
  os.kill(s['operationsPid'],0)
  time.sleep(20)
 assert shutil.disk_usage(p).free>=reg['minimumFreeBytes']
 state['stage']='one-complete-source-bound-assembly';save()
 with(p/'prepare.log').open('x')as log:subprocess.run(['nice','-n','19','bun',str(p/'prepare.ts')],cwd=p,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 result=json.loads((p/'assembly-result.json').read_text());assert result['passed'],'Input contract failed; preserve every row and violation without fitting'
 state['stage']='independent-python-assembly-verification';save()
 with(p/'verify.log').open('x')as log:subprocess.run(['nice','-n','19','python3',str(p/'verify.py')],cwd=p,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 assert json.loads((p/'independent-assembly-verification.json').read_text())['passed']
 state.update({'complete':True,'stage':'complete-verified-learning-inputs-no-fitter'})
except BaseException as error:state['errors'].append(repr(error));state['stage']='failed-preserve-all-no-retry';raise
finally:save()
